name: Theo Park

kit.name: Speedster (short-burst blinkwork)
kit.description: Not a marathon runner — a sewing machine.

moves.name: Needle
moves.description: A straight-line dash-through with a slash on exit.

moves.name: Basting
moves.description: Tags up to four enemies at walking pace, then hits all tags at once.

moves.name: Errand
moves.description: Instantly repositions one ALLY instead of himself — the only speedster whose speed is a gift.

signature.name: Seam Ripper
signature.description: Ten dashes stitched through the whole enemy formation in one second; the screen holds a comic-panel freeze of every pass before the damage lands.

nodes.name: Sharper Exit
nodes.effect: +8% damage

nodes.name: Second Wind Sprints
nodes.effect: +15% stamina cap

nodes.name: Double Stitch
nodes.effect: Needle's exit slash hits twice

nodes.name: Fifth Tag
nodes.effect: Basting tags up to five enemies

nodes.name: Momentum Debt
nodes.effect: +8% damage; dash hits build +1 power meter

nodes.name: Overlock
nodes.effect: +10% HP and +8% damage

nodes.name: Hot Handoff
nodes.effect: Swapping in grants 1s of 20% damage buff

nodes.name: Everyone's Order
nodes.effect: Delivery routes: +10% scavenge yield citywide

nodes.name: Designated Runner
nodes.effect: AI Theo uses Errand to pull low-HP allies out of crowds

nodes.name: Regular's Discount
nodes.effect: Haggle: -5% at restaurants and the Nite Owl

nodes.name: Free Refills

nodes.name: Route Memory

nodes.name: Tip Jar

nodes.name: Quick Thread

nodes.name: Twelve Pass
nodes.effect: EVOLUTION: twelve dashes instead of ten

nodes.name: Wider Weave
nodes.effect: Seam Ripper formation radius +1m

nodes.name: Pinking Shears
nodes.effect: Each pass applies a 1s slow

nodes.name: Cross-Stitch
nodes.effect: EVOLUTION: final pass converges on the biggest enemy for double damage

nodes.name: Bar Tack
nodes.effect: Basting-tagged enemies take +20% from Seam Ripper

nodes.name: The Splash Page
nodes.effect: EVOLUTION (poster): the comic-panel freeze holds a full beat; every pass gets its own panel

personality.summary: Chronically early and emotionally late; funny as a defense mechanism, then accidentally sincere; treats every kindness like a debt he has to repay at 200%.

romance.notes: Flirts at full speed and retreats faster. BINDING (docs/04 §1.5): his Romance-3 almost-moment plays at 0.1x time — the game's only non-combat slow-motion scene.

recruitHook: Cheap to recruit, hard to keep: he says yes immediately — too immediately — and the real recruitment is the follow-up mission where you learn he's quadruple-booked out of pure inability to disappoint anyone. Make him quit something. That's the price.
differentiation: Errand is the only ally-repositioning move in the game — his speed is a gift.
BINDING (docs/04 §1.5): Romance-3 scene at 0.1x time, the only non-combat slow-mo.
